estimate_semantics.note: only agg_trade ids name discrete events; for depth_diff an id step is a position in a sequence, and the affected book was invalidated and resnapshotted rather than asked to account for a count of missing updates

event_latency_ms.note: live delivery only; recovered rows are counted in loss.backfilled_events instead of being described as latency

health.method: derived read-side from the manifest's gap windows; the writer's own state timeline is reported separately because it is sticky

live.instantaneous_loss_note: a zero-length window still lost the ids it names: those holes carry no wall-clock duration but are counted as instantaneous loss events

collector_state.sticky_note: the writer never erases a recorded gap, so DEGRADED is monotone: a recoverable disconnect moves the state to DEGRADED and leaves it there. The live view above is the one that shows the recovery.

reconnect_downtime.method: read-side from the persisted WS_DISCONNECTED -> WS_CONNECTED lifecycle rows

health.degraded_window_sources: union of per-stream gap windows, the reconnect downtime derived from the lifecycle rows, and the writer's fatal record
